news.summary_zh: 與 Larry Page 相關的三個信託再次申請出售，正值 Alphabet 在慘烈的財報下跌後難以守住 $300。這是預設時間表使然，還是有更大因素壓制股價？

news.title: If You Invest $1,000 in Alphabet Today, Here’s What It Could Be Worth by 2030
news.summary: Alphabet just doubled Google Cloud sales and grew revenue 25%, yet the stock sank nearly 17% in a month. One model maps three very different outcomes for a $1,000 stake, and the gap between best and worst case is striking.
news.title_zh: 若您今天在 Alphabet 投資 $1,000，到 2030 可能值多少
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 的 Google Cloud 銷售額剛翻倍，營收增長 25%，股價卻在一個月內下跌近 17%。一個模型為 $1,000 持倉繪製了三種截然不同的結果，最佳與最差情況之間的差距驚人。

news.title: Google faces renewed challenge over $1.66bn advertising fine
news.summary: Advocate General Juliane Kokott has advised the Court of Justice of the EU to set aside the General Court's September 2024 judgment and return the case for a new ruling.
news.title_zh: Google 面臨 $1.66bn 廣告罰款的新挑戰
news.summary_zh: 歐盟法院總檢察長 Juliane Kokott 建議歐盟法院撤銷普通法院的 September 2024 判決，並將案件發回重審。

news.title: Broadcom Just Gained 25% in a Week: Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBroadcom stock is up 25% in the past week as chip stocks rebounded and Nvidia’s CEO exit sent investors to rivals like AMD. Nvidia’s turmoil gives AI buyers a reason to want a second supplier, and Broadcom helps design and supplies Alphabet’s custom TPU chips.
news.title_zh: Broadcom 一周內漲幅達 25%：獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Broadcom 股價在過去一周上漲 25%，因晶片股反彈且 Nvidia CEO 卸任導致投資者轉向 AMD 等競爭對手。Nvidia 的動盪讓 AI 買家有理由尋求第二供應商，而 Broadcom 協助設計並供應 Alphabet 的客製化 TPU 晶片。

news.title: Should You Buy Alphabet Stock Now That Google Will Let Customers Run Its AI Chips in Their Own Data Centers?
news.summary: The search giant's turning its AI chips into hardware it sells. Is the stock a buy around 28% below its peak?
news.title_zh: 現在 Google 讓客戶在自家資料中心運行其 AI 晶片，你應該買入 Alphabet 股票嗎？
news.summary_zh: 搜尋巨頭將其 AI 晶片轉型為可銷售的硬體。股價距離高點約 28% 時是否值得買入？

news.title: Why Alphabet Stock Was Moving Higher Today
news.summary: Trouble at Nvidia could create an opening for Alphabet's chip business.
news.title_zh: 為何 Alphabet 股價今日上漲
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 的麻煩可能為 Alphabet 的晶片業務創造機會。

news.title: Alphabet Climbs 3% as NVIDIA’s Leadership Shake-Up Puts Google’s AI Chips in the Spotlight; Microsoft Gains 2%, Amazon Ticks Up
news.summary: When NVIDIA's CEO walked out the door with no successor in place, one cloud giant's stock jumped while its rivals barely moved. The reason traces back to a chip strategy only two companies can claim, and a test arrives November 17.
news.title_zh: Alphabet 上漲 3%，NVIDIA 領導層變動使 Google AI 晶片成焦點；Microsoft 漲 2%，Amazon 小幅上揚
news.summary_zh: 當 NVIDIA CEO 在無繼任者情況下離職，一家雲端巨頭股價大漲而競爭對手幾乎不動。原因可追溯到僅有兩家公司能聲稱擁有的晶片策略，且一項考驗將於 November 17 到來。

news.title: Wall Street Models Lag Structural Reality, Prompting Me To Add an ‘Overvalued’ Apple
news.summary: Apple trades above every analyst target on the Street, yet one investor keeps buying after each earnings report. Why he passes on cheaper-looking Microsoft and Alphabet, and what memory costs could do to the thesis, makes for a contrarian case.
news.title_zh: 華爾街模型落後於結構性現實，促使我增持「高估」的蘋果
news.summary_zh: 蘋果股價高於華爾街所有分析師目標價，但一位投資人在每次財報後持續買入。為何他放棄看似更便宜的微軟和Alphabet，以及記憶體成本可能對投資論點造成的影響，構成了一個反向投資案例。

news.title: What to Watch When Berkshire Hathaway Files Its 13F on Monday
news.summary: Key TakeawaysBerkshire Hathaway’s 13F for the quarter ended Sept. 30 is due Monday, and its last one showed Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola, Alphabet and Bank of America as its five biggest positions.
news.title_zh: 伯克希爾·哈撒韋週一提交 13F 時應關注什麼
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：伯克希爾·哈撒韋截至 Sept. 30 季度的 13F 將於週一公布，其上一份報告顯示蘋果、美國運通、可口可樂、Alphabet 和美國銀行為其前五大持倉。

news.title: Arm CEO: The World Is “Ready and Willing” to Build the Data Centers America Blocks
news.summary: Key TakeawaysArm CEO Rene Haas warned that “the rest of the world is ready and willing” to build data centers if the US holds back, after local voters rejected 40 of 41 data center ballot measures by Scott Galloway’s count. Long-running AI agents don’t need to sit near their users, so the build-out can move abroad, and Alphabet’s Google just committed $15 billion to Malaysia, much of it for data center campuses.
news.title_zh: Arm執行長：世界已「準備好並願意」建設美國阻擋的數據中心
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Arm執行長Rene Haas警告稱，若美國阻撓，根據Scott Galloway的統計，當地選民否決了 40 項 41 數據中心投票提案，「世界其他地方已準備好並願意」建設數據中心。長期運行的AI代理不需靠近用戶，因此建設可移往海外，Alphabet旗下Google剛承諾投入 $15 billion 於馬來西亞，其中大部分用於數據中心園區。

news.title: Alphabet’s Misunderstood TPUs Are a Hidden Catalyst Investors Haven’t Yet Noticed
news.summary: Alphabet stock just tumbled, yet one investor keeps buying faster. A quiet business inside Google may be draining spending from the market's favorite chipmaker, and Wall Street still prices the company as if it doesn't exist. What is the market overlooking?
news.title_zh: Alphabet 被誤解的 TPU 是投資人尚未察覺的隱藏催化劑
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 股價剛暴跌，但有一位投資人卻加快買進步伐。Google 內部一項低調業務可能正在從市場最愛的晶片製造商手中吸走支出，而華爾街仍像該公司不存在一樣為其定價。市場忽略了什麼？

news.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk says about 20 to 30 million humanoid robots would match US output of goods and services, and Tesla’s Optimus is chasing that market. news.title: Jensen Didn’t Create the AI Boom. It Created Him.
news.summary: If you follow investors and reporters on X, you would get the sense that the resignation of Jensen Huang amounts to the end of the AI boom. A summary of my X feed Wednesday morning would go something like “I hope the Nvidia board knew what they were doing before ending the world as we know it.” But if you believe that to be true, you haven’t been paying attention. Because as much as Jensen created the AI boom (and clearly Nvidia’s GPU—the brains that trains AI models—did), the AI boom created Jensen. And that’s key to understanding the world that comes after his reign.
news.title_zh: 黃仁勳並未創造AI熱潮，是AI熱潮成就了他。
news.summary_zh: 如果你在X上關注投資人和記者，你會感覺到黃仁勳的辭職等同於AI熱潮的結束。我週三早上的X動態摘要大致是：「希望輝達董事會在結束我們所知的世界之前，知道自己在做什麼。」但如果你相信這是真的，說明你沒有留意。因為正如黃仁勳創造了AI熱潮（顯然輝達的GPU——訓練AI模型的大腦——確實做到了），AI熱潮也成就了黃仁勳。這是理解他統治結束後世界的關鍵。

items.summary: Senator Chris Coons, a Democrat from Delaware, says Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick "let America down" and is at center of a controversy involving Nvidia. Senator Coons wants to know if Lutnick made it easier for China to secure Nvidia advanced AI chips. Coons says he has no "concrete evidence" that US national security has been compromised. President Donald Trump says he has complete confidence in Lutnick. Senator Coons speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Jensen Didn’t Create the AI Boom. It Created Him.
items.summary: If you follow investors and reporters on X, you would get the sense that the resignation of Jensen Huang amounts to the end of the AI boom. A summary of my X feed Wednesday morning would go something like “I hope the Nvidia board knew what they were doing before ending the world as we know it.” But if you believe that to be true, you haven’t been paying attention. Because as much as Jensen created the AI boom (and clearly Nvidia’s GPU—the brains that trains AI models—did), the AI boom created Jensen. And that’s key to understanding the world that comes after his reign.

news.title: Micron Soars 10%, SK hynix Up 9% as CoreWeave Raises Outlook on “A Breakout Quarter”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron shares jumped 10% today, along with SK hynix, Sandisk, Nebius and Marvell, after CoreWeave raised its 2026 revenue outlook. CoreWeave’s $132.
news.title_zh: Micron 飆漲 10%，SK hynix 上漲 9%，因 CoreWeave 上調展望稱「突破性季度」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Micron 股價今日跳漲 10%，連同 SK hynix、Sandisk、Nebius 和 Marvell，因 CoreWeave 上調其 2026 營收展望。CoreWeave 的 $132。

news.title: Marvell and Intel Rally 7% as CoreWeave’s Results Reignite the AI Chip Trade; Taiwan Semiconductor Climbs 4%
news.summary: After a brutal month that wiped roughly 40% off some of the biggest names in AI silicon, one cloud provider's earnings and a quiet funding shift just sparked a rebound. Can it survive the Fed and the next AI financing scare?
news.title_zh: Marvell 和 Intel 漲 7%，CoreWeave 財報重燃 AI 晶片交易；台積電漲 4%
news.summary_zh: 經過慘烈一月，抹去 AI 晶片巨頭約 40% 市值，一家雲端供應商的財報與安靜的資金轉移引發反彈。能否熬過聯準會與下一波 AI 融資恐慌？

news.title: Coherent Rises 5% as CoreWeave’s Beat-and-Raise Revives the AI Trade: “A Breakout Quarter”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares rose 5% today after CoreWeave beat on revenue and raised its 2026 outlook, lifting Lumentum, Marvell, Credo and Astera Labs too. CoreWeave’s faster, better-funded buildout points to more demand for the optics Coherent makes.
news.title_zh: Coherent 上漲 5%，CoreWeave 的超預期並上調展望重燃 AI 題材：「突破性季度」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Coherent 股價今日上漲 5%，因 CoreWeave 營收超預期並上調其 2026 展望，帶動 Lumentum、Marvell、Credo 和 Astera Labs 同步上揚。CoreWeave 較快、資金更充足的建設指向對 Coherent 所製造光學元件的更多需求。

news.title: Credo and Lumentum Sink 14% in a Week as Democrats’ Sweep Hits AI Data Centers
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCredo Technology stock fell 14% in the past week after Democrats’ midterm sweep hit AI data center stocks, and Lumentum and Marvell fell with it. Credo had no bad news of its own, and its guidance for the current quarter still stands.
news.title_zh: 隨著民主黨大勝衝擊 AI 資料中心，Credo 和 Lumentum 一週內下跌 14%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Credo Technology 股價在過去一週下跌 14%，原因是民主黨在期中選舉大勝衝擊了 AI 資料中心股票，Lumentum 和 Marvell 也隨之下跌。Credo 本身沒有壞消息，其本季財測依然有效。

news.title: Lumentum Sinks 11% in a Week as Marvell’s All-Stock Offer Shrinks: “Our Demand Couldn’t Be Stronger”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 11% in the past week as the AI hardware selloff hit Marvell, whose all-stock offer drives its price, and it lagged Coherent’s rebound. September-quarter revenue rose 136.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 一週下跌 11%，因 Marvell 全股票收購要約縮水：「我們的需求再強烈也不過分」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Lumentum 過去一週下跌 11%，AI 硬體拋售潮衝擊 Marvell，其全股票收購要約決定 Lumentum 股價，且 Lumentum 落後於 Coherent 的反彈。九月季營收上升 136。

news.title: “The Next Trillion Dollar Company”: Marvell Is Up 82% in 2026. Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell is up 82% in 2026, even after losing about half its value since its June high. NVIDIA’s $2 billion investment, Jensen Huang’s trillion-dollar call and 46% data center growth last quarter drove the run.
news.title_zh: 「下一家兆元公司」：Marvell 上漲 82% 在 2026。獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Marvell 上漲 82% 在 2026，即使自六月高點以來已跌去約一半價值。輝達的 $2 billion 投資、黃仁勳的兆元呼聲以及 46% 資料中心上季成長推高了股價。

news.title: Even After a Cut, B. Riley’s $250 Target Says Marvell’s Selloff Went Too Far
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology is down 51% from its June high, and most of the drop since Oct. 28 tracks its all-stock deal for Lumentum and the Democratic sweep in Congress.
news.title_zh: 即使下調後，B. Riley 的 $250 目標價顯示 Marvell 跌太深
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Marvell Technology 從六月高點下跌 51%，且自 Oct. 28 以來的大部分跌幅反映了其收購 Lumentum 的全股票交易以及民主黨在國會橫掃獲勝。

news.title: AMD Soars 6%, Broadcom Up 6% as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Exits
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 6% after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO, and Broadcom rose with it. IonQ, SoundHound and Oklo fell instead, as investors cut back on the riskiest AI bets.
news.title_zh: AMD 飆漲 6%，Broadcom 上漲 6%，隨著 Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳離職
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 AMD 股價在黃仁勳辭去 Nvidia CEO 後跳升 6%，Broadcom 同步上漲。IonQ、SoundHound 和 Oklo 則下跌，因投資人減碼最具風險的 AI 押注。

news.title: Craig-Hallum Just Cut Its Oklo Target From $53 to $27 After a Better-Than-Expected Quarter
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCraig-Hallum cut its Oklo price target to $27 from $53 on Nov. 9 and kept its Hold rating, three days after Oklo reported a narrower third-quarter loss than expected.
news.title_zh: Craig-Hallum 在優於預期的季度後將 Oklo 目標價從 $53 to $27 下調
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Craig-Hallum 於 Nov. 9 將 Oklo 目標價從 $53 下調至 $27，並維持持有評級，這是在 Oklo 報告第三季虧損縮小優於預期的三天後。

news.title: Oklo Gets Final DOE Operational Clearance For Groves-1 Reactor – Retail Eyes 85% Upside By 2026-End
news.summary: The DOE’s operational restriction clearance will allow the reactor to enter its research, testing, and training phase.
news.title_zh: Oklo 獲得 DOE 核准 Groves-1 反應爐最終運營許可 – 散戶關注 2026 年底前 85% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: DOE 的運營限制許可將允許反應爐進入研究、測試和訓練階段。

news.title: Oklo Rises 4% as DOE Clears Groves-1 Reactor for Unrestricted Operations: “Reset the Nuclear Industry’s Expectations”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo shares jumped 4% today after the Department of Energy cleared its Groves-1 test reactor for unrestricted operations. Groves-1 shows Oklo can build fast, but it still needs a cost for its first Aurora powerhouse and a binding customer.
news.title_zh: Oklo 上漲 4%，因 DOE 核准 Groves-1 反應爐進行無限制運營：「重設核能產業期望」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價今日跳升 4%，因能源部核准其 Groves-1 試驗反應爐進行無限制運營。Groves-1 顯示 Oklo 能快速建設，但仍需首座 Aurora 電廠的成本和具約束力的客戶。

news.title: Oklo Receives DOE Clearance for Groves-1 Reactor Research, Testing and Training Operations
news.summary: Oklo Inc. (NYSE:OKLO) announced that the US Department of Energy (DOE) has cleared the final operations hold point for its Groves Isotope Test Reactor (Groves-1) in Lockhart, Texas, allowing the facility to proceed with research, testing and personnel training activities.
news.title_zh: Oklo 獲得 DOE 批准 Groves-1 反應爐研究、測試和培訓運營
news.summary_zh: Oklo Inc. (NYSE:OKLO) 宣佈美國能源部 (DOE) 已批准其 Groves 同位素測試反應爐 (Groves-1) 位於德克薩斯州洛克哈特) 的最終運營控制點,允許該設施繼續進行研究、測試和人員培訓活動。

news.title: Oklo Soars 14% in a Week on a Narrower Loss and a Deal for 27 Reactors’ Worth of Forgings
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo stock rose 14% in the week to Nov. 9 on a narrower third-quarter loss and a forging deal for 27 reactors.
news.title_zh: Oklo 因虧損收窄和 27 反應堆鍛件交易，一週內飆升 14%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價在截至 Nov. 9 的一週內上漲 14%，得益於第三季虧損收窄和 27 反應堆的鍛件交易。

news.title: OKLO Stock Is On Track To Reverse 6 Weeks Of Losses, But This Analyst Warns Nuclear Euphoria Is Fading
news.summary: OKLO stock is headed higher on strong third-quarter earnings and a manufacturing agreement with U.S. Forged Rings to support the long-term deployment of its Aurora powerhouses.
news.title_zh: OKLO 股票有望扭轉 6 週的虧損，但分析師警告核能狂熱正在消退
news.summary_zh: OKLO 股票因強勁的第三季財報及與 U.S. Forged Rings 簽訂製造協議以支援其 Aurora 發電廠長期部署而走高。

news.title: Oklo Is Down 86% From Its High. Will Shares Soar When Meta's Reactor Comes Online?
news.summary: SMR stocks are getting hammered alongside AI stocks.
news.title_zh: Oklo從高點下跌86%。當Meta的反應器上線時，股價會飆升嗎？
news.summary_zh: SMR股票連同AI股票一起遭重擊。

news.title: H.C. Wainwright’s $90 Target Says Oklo’s Selloff Went Too Far
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOn Nov. 9, H. C. Wainwright repeated its Buy rating and $90 price target on Oklo.
news.title_zh: H.C. Wainwright 的 $90 目標價表明 Oklo 的拋售過度
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要在 Nov. 9，H. C. Wainwright 重申其對 Oklo 的買入評級及 $90 目標價。

news.title: Oklo: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
news.summary: Oklo's plan to sell fuel-fabrication capacity to external reactor operators could turn its fuel business into a standalone revenue stream.
news.title_zh: Oklo：3 給長期投資者的關鍵要點
news.summary_zh: Oklo 向外部反應堆運營商出售燃料製造產能的計劃，可能將其燃料業務轉變為獨立的收入來源。

news.title: Fervo Energy Just Dropped 35% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysFervo Energy stock fell 35% in the past month, a bit less than Bloom Energy and Oklo, as AI power stocks sold off and a short seller’s report added to the pressure. Fervo’s first Cape Station GeoBlock started commercial operation a day early, on Sept.
news.title_zh: Fervo Energy 一個月下跌 35%。現在是賣出時機，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Fervo Energy 股票在過去一個月下跌 35%，跌幅略小於 Bloom Energy 和 Oklo，因 AI 電力股遭拋售且做空報告增加壓力。Fervo 的首座 Cape Station GeoBlock 提早一天於九月開始商業運轉。

news.title: NuScale Just Hit a New 52-Week Low After Losing 26% in a Week. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNuScale Power fell 26% in a week to a new 52-week low as power and nuclear stocks, Oklo and Vistra among them, sold off around the election. NuScale had no bad news of its own, though Wedbush initiated coverage at Underperform.
news.title_zh: NuScale 創 52 週新低，單週下跌 26%。拋售是否過度？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點NuScale Power 一週下跌 26%，創下 52 週新低，因電力與核能股（包括 Oklo 和 Vistra）在大選前後遭拋售。NuScale 本身無利空消息，但 Wedbush 以「表現遜於大盤」評級開始覆蓋。

news.title: Cerebras Soars on Sales; Cisco Down on Expectations Miss | Stock Movers
news.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Shares of Cerebras Systems (CBRS) soared ahead of the US market open after the chipmaker gave a sales guidance well above estimates, while unveiling new deals with Oracle and Microsoft. A key investor concern is a rollout delay in the firm’s contract with OpenAI. - Shares of Cisco Systems (CSCO) declined in the early session after the networking gear maker reported a 21% rise in product orders in fiscal 1Q, missing expectations and marking a slowdown from the previous period. - Shares of Applied Materials (AMAT) inched higher after the company reported fourth-quarter results that beat expectations and gave an outlook for adjusted first-quarter earnings that is stronger than expected. news.title: JPMorgan Cut Its IREN Target to $55. It Still Sees 148% Upside
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJPMorgan cut its IREN price target to $55 from $65 on Monday and kept its Overweight rating, leaving 148% upside after a 68% drop in a year. IREN pushed its $4 billion revenue run-rate target into early 2027 after Microsoft asked for a network upgrade, and $6 billion of this fiscal year’s build still needs funding.
news.title_zh: JPMorgan 將 IREN 目標價下調至 $55。仍看好 148% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要JPMorgan 週一將 IREN 目標價從 $65 下調至 $55，維持增持評級，在一年下跌 68% 後仍留有 148% 上漲空間。IREN 在微軟要求網路升級後，將其 $4 billion 營收運行率目標推遲至 2027 初，且本財年建設的 $6 billion 仍需資金。

news.title: Microsoft Dumps Oracle. Good News: Those Old Chips Renew at a “20% Premium”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle because its older Nvidia chips no longer fit Microsoft’s specifications, Bloomberg reported. Oracle says GPUs renewed last quarter, mostly four years or older, went at a 20% premium, and IREN just recontracted older H100s at double the price.
news.title_zh: Microsoft 棄用 Oracle。好消息：舊晶片續約享有「20% 溢價」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：彭博社報導，Microsoft 正逐步終止一項向 Oracle 租用 AI 運算的 2023 協議，因其較舊的 Nvidia 晶片不再符合 Microsoft 規範。Oracle 表示，上季續約的 GPU 大多為四年或以上機齡，享有 20% 溢價，而 IREN 剛以雙倍價格重新簽約較舊的 H100s。
